title: Nonlinear Participation Factor-based Power System Model Reduction Addressing Near-Resonance Conditions
summary: This paper proposes an adaptive model reduction approach based on nonlinear participation factors (NPFs) which determines the most effective selection of unimportant generators in a power system to be linearized to accelerate time-domain simulation for the entire system. The method enables a dynamic transition between the full-order model, and a hybrid reduced model. It uses modal energies to rank system modes under contingencies, and computes NPFs for highly energized modes based on Normal Form theory.
